facts.business: Mayank Cattle Food Limited is engaged in the business of Fast Moving Consumer Goods (FMCG), specifically raw unfiltered edible maize oil and cake.

segments.name: Raw unfiltered edible maize oil and cake

key_risks: Recoverability of loans and advances to related parties
Inventory valuation of finished goods based on contract price
facts.related_party_note: The Company has provided loans of ₹ 238.70 lakhs to related party during the financial year ended on March 31, 2026. The transactions with related party are significant due to their volume and the risk associated with their recoverability.
